passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.1
passages.text: Siqua tamen caecis errabunt scripta lituris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.2
passages.text: Oblitus a dominae caede libellus erit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.3
passages.text: Dextra tenet calamum, strictum tenet altera ferrum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.4
passages.text: Et iacet in gremio charta soluta meo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.5
passages.text: Haec est Aeolidos fratri scribentis imago;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.6
passages.text: Sic videor duro posse placere patri.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.7
passages.text: Ipse necis cuperem nostrae spectator adesset,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.8
passages.text: Auctorisque oculis exigeretur opus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.9
passages.text: Ut ferus est multoque suis truculentior Euris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.10
passages.text: Spectasset siccis vulnera nostra genis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.11
passages.text: Scilicet est aliquid, cum saevis vivere ventis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.12
passages.text: Ingenio populi convenit ille sui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.13
passages.text: Ille Noto Zephyroque et Sithonio Aquiloni

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.14
passages.text: Imperat et pinnis, Eure proterve, tuis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.15
passages.text: Imperat heu! ventis, tumidae non imperat irae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.16
passages.text: Possidet et vitiis regna minora suis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.17
passages.text: Quid iuvat admotam per avorum nomina caelo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.18
passages.text: Inter cognatos posse referre Iovem?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.19
passages.text: Num minus infestum, funebria munera, ferrum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.20
passages.text: Feminea teneo, non mea tela, manu?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.21
passages.text: O utinam, Macareu, quae nos commisit in unum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.22
passages.text: Venisset leto serior hora meo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.23
passages.text: Cur umquam plus me, frater, quam frater amasti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.24
passages.text: Et tibi, non debet quod soror esse, fui?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.25
passages.text: Ipsa quoque incalui, qualemque audire solebam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.26
passages.text: Nescio quem sensi corde tepente deum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.27
passages.text: Fugerat ore color; macies adduxerat artus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.28
passages.text: Sumebant minimos ora coacta cibos;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.29
passages.text: Nec somni faciles et nox erat annua nobis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.30
passages.text: Et gemitum nullo laesa dolore dabam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.31
passages.text: Nec, cur haec facerem, poteram mihi reddere causam

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.32
passages.text: Nec noram, quid amans esset; at illud eram.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.33
passages.text: Prima malum nutrix animo praesensit anili;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.34
passages.text: Prima mihi nutrix 'Aeoli,' dixit, 'amas!'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.35
passages.text: Erubui, gremioque pudor deiecit ocellos;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.36
passages.text: Haec satis in tacita signa fatentis erant.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.37
passages.text: Iamque tumescebant vitiati pondera ventris,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.38
passages.text: Aegraque furtivum membra gravabat onus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.39
passages.text: Quas mihi non herbas, quae non medicamina nutrix

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.40
passages.text: Attulit audaci supposuitque manu,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.41
passages.text: Ut penitus nostris — hoc te celavimus unum —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.42
passages.text: Visceribus crescens excuteretur onus?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.43
passages.text: A, nimium vivax admotis restitit infans

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.44
passages.text: Artibus et tecto tutus ab hoste fuit!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.45
passages.text: Iam noviens erat orta soror pulcherrima Phoebi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.46
passages.text: Et nova luciferos Luna movebat equos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.47
passages.text: Nescia, quae faceret subitos mihi causa dolores,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.48
passages.text: Et rudis ad partus et nova miles eram.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.49
passages.text: Nec tenui vocem. 'quid,' ait, 'tua crimina prodis?'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.50
passages.text: Oraque clamantis conscia pressit anus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.51
passages.text: Quid faciam infelix? gemitus dolor edere cogit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.52
passages.text: Sed timor et nutrix et pudor ipse vetant.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.53
passages.text: Contineo gemitus elapsaque verba reprendo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.54
passages.text: Et cogor lacrimas conbibere ipsa meas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.55
passages.text: Mors erat ante oculos, et opem Lucina negabat —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.56
passages.text: Et grave, si morerer, mors quoque crimen erat —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.57
passages.text: Cum super incumbens scissa tunicaque comaque

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.58
passages.text: Pressa refovisti pectora nostra tuis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.59
passages.text: Et mihi 'vive, soror, soror o carissima,' dixti;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.60
passages.text: 'Vive nec unius corpore perde duos!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.61
passages.text: Spes bona det vires; fratri nam nupta futura es.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.62
passages.text: Illius, de quo mater, et uxor eris.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.63
passages.text: Mortua, crede mihi, tamen ad tua verba revixi:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.64
passages.text: Et positum est uteri crimen onusque mei.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.65
passages.text: Quid tibi grataris? media sedet Aeolus aula;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.66
passages.text: Crimina sunt oculis subripienda patris.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.67
passages.text: Frugibus infantem ramisque albentis olivae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.68
passages.text: Et levibus vittis sedula celat anus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.69
passages.text: Fictaque sacra facit dicitque precantia verba;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.70
passages.text: Dat populus sacris, dat pater ipse viam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.71
passages.text: Iam prope limen erat — patrias vagitus ad auris

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.72
passages.text: Venit, et indicio proditur ille suo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.73
passages.text: Eripit infantem mentitaque sacra revelat

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.74
passages.text: Aeolus; insana regia voce sonat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.75
passages.text: Ut mare fit tremulum, tenui cum stringitur aura,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.76
passages.text: Ut quatitur tepido fraxina virga Noto,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.77
passages.text: Sic mea vibrari pallentia membra videres;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.78
passages.text: Quassus ab inposito corpore lectus erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.79
passages.text: Inruit et nostrum vulgat clamore pudorem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.80
passages.text: Et vix a misero continet ore manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.81
passages.text: Ipsa nihil praeter lacrimas pudibunda profudi;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.82
passages.text: Torpuerat gelido lingua retenta metu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.83
passages.text: Iamque dari parvum canibusque avibusque nepotem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.84
passages.text: Iusserat, in solis destituique locis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.85
passages.text: Vagitus dedit ille miser — sensisse putares —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.86
passages.text: Quaque suum poterat voce rogabat avum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.87
passages.text: Quid mihi tunc animi credis, germane, fuisse —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.88
passages.text: Nam potes ex animo colligere ipse tuo —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.89
passages.text: Cum mea me coram silvas inimicus in altas

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.90
passages.text: Viscera montanis ferret edenda lupis?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.91
passages.text: Exierat thalamo; tunc demum pectora plangi

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.92
passages.text: Contigit inque meas unguibus ire genas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.93
passages.text: Interea patrius vultu maerente satelles

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.94
passages.text: Venit et indignos edidit ore sonos:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.95
passages.text: 'Aeolus hunc ensem mittit tibi' — tradidit ensem —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.96
passages.text: 'Et iubet ex merito scire, quid iste velit.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.97
passages.text: Scimus, et utemur violento fortiter ense;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.98
passages.text: Pectoribus condam dona paterna meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.99
passages.text: His mea muneribus, genitor, conubia donas?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.100
passages.text: Hac tua dote, pater, filia dives erit?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.101
passages.text: Tolle procul, decepte, faces, Hymenaee, maritas

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.102
passages.text: Et fuge turbato tecta nefanda pede!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.103
passages.text: Ferte faces in me quas fertis, Erinyes atrae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.104
passages.text: Et meus ex isto luceat igne rogus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.105
passages.text: Nubite felices Parca meliore sorores,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.106
passages.text: Amissae memores sed tamen este mei!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.107
passages.text: Quid puer admisit tam paucis editus horis?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.108
passages.text: Quo laesit facto vix bene natus avum?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.109
passages.text: Si potuit meruisse necem, meruisse putetur —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.110
passages.text: A, miser admisso plectitur ille meo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.111
passages.text: Nate, dolor matris, rabidarum praeda ferarum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.112
passages.text: Ei mihi! natali dilacerate tuo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.113
passages.text: Nate, parum fausti miserabile pignus amoris —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.114
passages.text: Haec tibi prima dies, haec tibi summa fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.115
passages.text: Non mihi te licuit lacrimis perfundere iustis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.116
passages.text: In tua non tonsas ferre sepulcra comas;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.117
passages.text: Non super incubui, non oscula frigida carpsi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.118
passages.text: Diripiunt avidae viscera nostra ferae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.119
passages.text: Ipsa quoque infantis cum vulnere prosequar umbras

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.120
passages.text: Nec mater fuero dicta nec orba diu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.121
passages.text: Tu tamen, o frustra miserae sperate sorori,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.122
passages.text: Sparsa, precor, nati collige membra tui,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.123
passages.text: Et refer ad matrem socioque inpone sepulcro,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.124
passages.text: Urnaque nos habeat quamlibet arta duos!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.125
passages.text: Vive memor nostri, lacrimasque in vulnera funde,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.126
passages.text: Neve reformida corpus amantis amans.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.127
passages.text: Tu, rogo, dilectae nimium mandata sororis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 11.128
passages.text: Perfice; mandatis obsequar ipsa patris!
